title: alnus viridis var. fruticosa
intro: Alnus viridis var. fruticosa, commonly known as Green Alder Dwarf or Dwarf Green Alder, is a small shrub or tree species belonging to the birch family (Betulaceae). This plant is used in traditional medicine and is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties that may help to reduce stress, improve digestion, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Alnus viridis var. fruticosa include its ability to inhibit histamine release, which can help alleviate allergy symptoms, as well as its potential to act as an anti-cancer agent due to the presence of bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of this plant, including quercetin, isorhapontigenin, and rhaponticin, are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects and potential applications.
